assumptions.time_encoding: Unix seconds interpreted with UTC clock fields as Taiwan wall-clock, matching the HTML formatter
assumptions.excluded: 01:00-05:00 is excluded from the requested three buckets
assumptions.entry: next one-minute bar open after close confirmation
assumptions.bucket_exit: forced flat at each requested bucket end for clean attribution
assumptions.formal_signal: A1 strict adjacent-bar pivot only; B and B2 remain research-only
assumptions.pivot_segment_proxy: P must be the lowest/highest of the trailing five bars including P
assumptions.cash_conversion: TMF is NT$10 per index point
